gate0.name: PIT / Lookahead
gate0.details: detect_lookahead CLEAN on all 3 files. Manual C1-C11 verified. DD brake uses dd_lag (t-1 lagged, line 13). No full-sample stats (C1). No same-day circular (C2/C8/C9). AvgTV20 properly lagged (C10). No FRED data (C11 N/A). Z_Score_Aligned used (C13). Arrow dataset access (C15). Pure overlay on clean base signal.

gate1.name: Implementation
gate1.details: N=30, commission=15bps, LIQ>=2e8 (via base run_all.R). Turnover=140.8% (<600%). DD overlay is deterministic linear ramp (DD_START=5%, DD_FULL=15%, DD_MIN_EXP=0.35). No additional parameters to overfit.

gate2.name: Robustness
gate2.details: OOS retention 0.30 (IS SR 0.341 / OOS SR 0.101) -- severely degraded. Rolling3Y_Pos=52.2% (barely above coin flip). Stress=3/3 outperform (strong). MaxConsecNegAlpha=10 months (poor). Alpha trend improving (recent 3Y SR 0.487 vs full 0.279) but base is too weak.

gate3.name: Performance
gate3.details: SR 0.279 (FAIL, target 0.8+). CAGR 2.77% (FAIL, target 16%). MDD 24.17% (PASS, <25%). IR -0.337 (FAIL, underperforms KOSPI200). Calmar 0.115. The aggressive DD brake successfully compressed MDD from 64.3% to 24.2% but destroyed returns entirely -- CAGR crushed from 8.45% to 2.77%.

gate4.name: Statistical
gate4.details: FMB Score t-stat=1.352 (not significant, p>0.1). IC mean positive but low. DSR not available. FF5 alpha: base factor_engine Score FMB t=1.35 -- no statistical alpha. The underlying IndMom+QualityGate signal is too weak in KR market for DD overlay to salvage.

gate5.name: Diversification / Role Honesty
gate5.details: Claimed role: diversifier. BM_Corr=0.476 (moderate). However, with SR 0.279 and negative IR, this adds no diversification value. A diversifier must still contribute positive expected return; M2 underperforms both KOSPI200 and risk-free. Role honesty: diversifier claim is not dishonest, but the strategy fails to deliver on any role.

reasons: CAGR 2.77% -- far below 16% target and below risk-free
DD 5/15 overlay too aggressive -- destroyed return while achieving MDD target
FMB Score t-stat 1.35 -- no statistical alpha

comparison.vs_base: Base SR 0.324 / CAGR 8.45% / MDD 64.3%. M2 improved MDD dramatically (-40pp) but CAGR lost 67%. Net: worse risk-adjusted (SR 0.279 < 0.324).
comparison.vs_dd722: DD722 variant SR 0.325 / CAGR 4.57% / MDD 37.4% dominates M2 on return with acceptable MDD.
comparison.vs_other_mutations: M2 has best MDD (24.2%) but worst CAGR among all S5 variants. The Sharpe-MDD tradeoff is unfavorable -- too much return sacrificed for drawdown control.
comparison.mutation_verdict: DD 5/15 is over-engineered for a weak base signal. The 35% minimum exposure floor means the strategy spends most of its time at reduced exposure, compounding the already low alpha.

strengths: PIT fully clean, no lookahead violations
weaknesses: CAGR 2.77% below risk-free -- negative real return
Negative IR: KOSPI200 outperforms on every horizon
OOS retention 0.30 -- overfitting concern in IS period
DD overlay destroys the little alpha that existed
FMB t-stat 1.35 -- no significant factor premium
recommendation: DISCARD. The underlying IndMom+QualityGate signal in KR market is too weak (FMB t=1.35) for any DD overlay to improve. M2's aggressive 5/15 DD achieves target MDD but at catastrophic return cost. If IndMom is to be pursued, it needs a fundamentally different construction (e.g., pure sector rotation without stock selection) rather than post-hoc drawdown management.
